result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_degree_distribution()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get degree distribution as a mapping from degree to count. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L13791-L13829){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_degree_distribution() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns a histogram of node degrees, showing how many nodes have each degree value. Useful for analyzing network topology and identifying hub nodes or scale-free properties. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping degree values to the number of nodes with that degree. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Get degree distribution: ::: {#d560e4dd .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Hub") .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge("Hub", "A") .add_edge("Hub", "B") .add_edge("Hub", "C") .add_edge("Hub", "D") ) dist = graph.get_degree_distribution() # Returns {1: 4, 4: 1}; 4 nodes with degree 1, 1 node with degree 4 dist ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {1: 4, 4: 1} ``` ::: :::
